note: The trained gradient-boosted model vs Gaffer's *shipped* component projection (the exact code the site runs, incl. per-position goal points, appearance model, clean-sheet Poisson and bonus proxy) vs FPL's own xP vs a naive recent-form baseline, on a season the model never trained on.
